private_policy_additions: Robot teams: robot_hero 10001032 referenced by 72 level-10 teams is absent from source and is dropped (no team becomes empty); source equip flags have no recovered item mapping, so robots field no equipment and skill levels 1.
Rank-1 frame 120001004 (stack cap 1, no overflow) travels in its own TOP_FLOOR_DAILY_FRAME mail at most once per player and server, so the daily TOP_FLOOR_DAILY mail always stays claimable.
Best-rank reward mail: title 'Top Floor Best Rank Reward' (source names none), sender arena_mail_sender, one mail per settled fight (source key = attempt id).

START replay: an identical START (same formation, pet, enemy, revenge flag) while the fight is open or within 60 s of its start returns the same attempt/result; result deadline 10 min; a fight whose attempt can no longer resolve is closed without result and keeps its consumed ticket.

Opponent refresh (273) is free and unlimited; the refresh counter resets with the 05:00 ticket day. A robot whose wire table_id equals an offered player's is skipped because START names table_id only.
Live rank list (301 rank_type 1) shows ranks 1..50; robots use wire id team + region*100000.
Report retention: a report answers while any retained record (last 10 per player) references it.
deviations_from_plan: The settlement/abandoned-fight reconcile provider runs in gxb-api every 30 s (combat launcher, entropy key ring and owner inputs are composed there), not in gxb-worker. It implements generation.ReconcileProvider and can move.

Top Floor routes and the first production Combat composition register only when GXB_COMBAT_ENTROPY_KEYS / GXB_COMBAT_ENTROPY_KEY_CURRENT are configured (fail closed); GXB_COMBAT_WORKER_BINARY defaults to gxb-combat-worker beside gxb-api.
START pins the active content revision on its operation when the request carries none (bootstrap binder pattern), so all owner reads observe one revision.
Cumulative migration lock repaired to list 00062-00064 (pre-existing omission) and 00065.
known_limitations: Player ids are allocated from server*100000+1, so real players can have table_id <= 25000, which the stock client classifies as robots; enemy rows then carry each hero's template table_id in partner_id so hero display stays correct, but robot-only client paths (e.g. avatar click) may treat such players as robots. Identity allocation is outside I7C-5B.
